title: Microsoft Teams: automatic recording and transcription for call queues
notes: claim 81: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the access and announcement PowerShell examples are incomplete, and the announcement example includes prose that is not executable PowerShell. The licensing guidance omits the Teams Phone licence each Queues app user needs, and the storage question overlooks published SharePoint limits.

claims.claim: Automatic Recording for Call Queue is a first-party Teams solution for automatic recording and transcription of inbound queue calls.
claims.quote: Automatic Recording for Call Queue is a first-party Microsoft Teams solution that enables administrators to configure automatic recording and transcription of inbound call queue calls.

claims.claim: The checklist names controls that have no corresponding controls-table row.

claims.fix: Remove the checklist instructions to check conference mode, call-answering membership and explicit recording consent, to configure SharePoint site administrators, and to review SharePoint site access. claims.where: Open questions: storage charge or quota

claims.quote:
Max storage per site (site collection) | 25 TB | 25 TB | 25 TB | 25 TB | 25 TB |
You can purchase an unlimited amount of more SharePoint storage.
claims.fix: Remove the Open questions bullet 'Is there a storage charge or quota for the SharePoint site? Learn points to the SharePoint service description and states no extra Teams Phone licensing.' General SharePoint site and tenant storage limits are published; the absence of a feature-specific price does not make those limits unknown.
